evidence: Modifies cmake introspection checks, configuration headers, and cross-compilation devtools for Windows builds.
rationale: Removes an obsolete CMake probe for SetThreadDescription and drops legacy MSVCRT Nix logic following the 33.x branch-off. The PR description notes this is "a follow-up reverting #36057, now that we've branched off for `33.x`" and documents the new MinGW-w64 12.0 requirement.
